entities.name: Robert Windsor-Clive, 1st Earl of Plymouth

entities.summary: Robert George Windsor-Clive, 1st Earl of Plymouth, known as the 14th Baron Windsor between 1869 and 1905, was a British nobleman and Conservative politician. He was the founding President of the London Society.
